lore.nomansland.pasta_with_pesto: A Pasta dish made with Pesto Bottle and a mushroom.
lore.nomansland.horse_steak: A food cooked from Raw Horse.
lore.nomansland.cooked_venison: A food cooked from Raw Venison.
lore.nomansland.cooked_frog_leg: A food cooked from Frog Leg.
lore.nomansland.seared_venison: A food made from mushrooms, Onion, Carrot, Baked Potato and Cooked Venison.
lore.nomansland.sweet_tart: A food made from Pine Nuts, Sweet Berries, Chicken Egg and Wheat.
lore.nomansland.maple_tart: A food made from Maple Syrup Bottle, Chicken Egg and Wheat.
lore.nomansland.fruit_cake: A food made from Milk, Pear, Apple, Sweet Berries, Chicken Egg and Wheat. Place it and use a Knife on it to cut 7 slices.
lore.nomansland.pear_cobbler_slice: A slice of Pear Cobbler. Use a Knife on a placed Pear Cobbler to cut a slice, or cut the whole cobbler on a Cutting Board.
lore.nomansland.fruit_cake_slice: A slice of Fruit Cake. Use a Knife on a placed Fruit Cake to cut a slice, or cut the whole cake on a Cutting Board.
lore.nomansland.honeyed_apple: A food made from Honey Bottle and Apple.
lore.nomansland.syruped_pear: A food made from Maple Syrup Bottle and Pear.
lore.nomansland.trail_mix: A food made from Pine Nuts, Pumpkin Seeds and Walnuts.
lore.nomansland.candied_pear: A food made from Pear and Sugar Ingredients.
lore.nomansland.pot_of_witch_stew: A food cooked in a Cooking Pot with Raw Billhook Bass, Frog Leg, Duckweed, Brown Mushroom and Onion. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
lore.nomansland.stallion_strips: A food cooked in a Cooking Pot with Pesto Bottle, Raw Horse, Carrot and Onion. Place it and use it to take each of its 5 strips.
lore.nomansland.pesto_bottle: A drink made from Pine Nuts, Brown Mushroom and Fern.
lore.nomansland.maple_mead_bottle: A drink fermented in a Fermentation Vessel with Maple Syrup Bottle.
lore.nomansland.billhook_bass: A freshwater fish caught in rivers and lakes.
entity.nomansland.billhook_bass.descript: A freshwater fish found in rivers and lakes.
lore.nomansland.billhook_bass_bucket: A bucket holding a live Raw Billhook Bass. Empty it to release the fish, or keep it as a pet in an aquarium.
lore.nomansland.bandage: A strip of cloth that heals 2 hearts. Hold use to bandage yourself, or use it on another creature to patch them up instead.
lore.nomansland.antidote_bandage: A Bandage treated with mushroom and honey. Heals 2 hearts and cures Poison.
lore.nomansland.medicinal_bandage: A Bandage treated with maple syrup and charcoal. Heals 2 hearts and cures Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Nausea, and Blindness.
lore.nomansland.warding_bandage: A Bandage sealed with Resin and Gold. Heals 2 hearts and grants two minutes of Absorption.
lore.nomansland.explosive: A paper-wrapped charge of Gunpowder that can be thrown. It blasts apart blocks, and can be used to mine ores.
lore.nomansland.firebomb: A throwable bomb of Gunpowder and Resin. It bursts into flame, but won't damage blocks.
lore.nomansland.ink_bomb: A throwable bomb packed with ink. It leaves a cloud that blinds and slows everything caught in it, and reveals invisible creatures.
lore.nomansland.incendiary_arrow: An arrow dipped in Resin Oil that sets its target on fire.
lore.nomansland.resin: A sticky sap collected from logs with a Tap and a Cauldron. Used for Firebombs, Resin Oil, and Warding Bandages.
lore.nomansland.resin_oil_bottle: A bottle of flammable oil that can be thrown. Creatures doused in it catch fire far more easily.
lore.nomansland.tap: A spout that can be fixed to the side of a log above a Cauldron to slowly collect Resin, or Maple Syrup from Maple logs.
lore.nomansland.monster_anchor: A cursed block found in ancestral ruins. Monsters slain near it are dragged back to life after a while. Break it to stop the cycle.
lore.nomansland.warding_effigy: A small effigy that keeps monsters from spawning or wandering nearby. Stack up to four on one block to widen its range.
lore.nomansland.ancestral_effigy: An ancient carved effigy found in ancestral ruins.
lore.nomansland.ancestral_carving: Ancient stone that can be carved with an Ancient Bronze Chisel.
lore.nomansland.ancient_bronze_chisel: An ancient tool found in ancestral ruins, used to carve Ancestral Carvings.
lore.nomansland.ritual_pick: An ancient bronze pick found in ancestral ruins.
lore.nomansland.ancestral_oath_sword: An ancient bronze sword found in ancestral ruins.
lore.nomansland.ancient_bronze_mask: An ancient bronze mask found in ancestral ruins. Slowly regenerates its wearer's health.
lore.nomansland.ancient_bronze_bell: An ancient bronze bell found in ancestral ruins.
lore.nomansland.living_urn: An urn with a restless spirit inside. Throw it to shatter it into a cloud that pacifies monsters for a minute.
lore.nomansland.spike_trap: A plate of spikes that hurts anything that walks into it. It can be toggled with Flux Power.
lore.nomansland.sturdy_scute: A thick scute shed by Tortoises. Crafted into a Tortoise Shell.
lore.nomansland.tortoise_shell: A heavy helmet made from Sturdy Scutes.
lore.nomansland.tortoise_egg: A Tortoise egg that will hatch if left on sand.
lore.nomansland.pebbles: Small stones scattered on the ground that often hold Flint. Can be crafted back into Gravel.
lore.nomansland.quartzite: A hard stone made from Quartz and Calcite.
lore.nomansland.budding_quartzite: A Quartzite block that slowly grows Quartzite buds on its faces. It can't be picked up, even with Silk Touch.
lore.nomansland.icicles: Sharp ice that hangs from ceilings.
lore.nomansland.wooden_platform: A thin wooden platform you can jump up through and drop down through by sneaking.
lore.nomansland.wooden_scaffolding: Wooden scaffolding that can be climbed and traversed. It needs support from below or from nearby scaffolding.
lore.nomansland.thatch: A roofing block woven from Straw.
lore.nomansland.coarse_silt: Silt mixed with gravel. Plants won't grow on it.
lore.nomansland.vermilion_froglight: A bright light source produced when a Frog eats a Magma Cube.
lore.nomansland.field_mushroom_colony: A cluster of Field Mushrooms that grows on Rich Soil. Harvest it with Shears or a Knife.
lore.nomansland.shelf_mushroom: A flat mushroom that grows on the sides of logs.
lore.nomansland.apple_crate: A crate packed with Apples, for compact storage.
lore.nomansland.pear_crate: A crate packed with Pears, for compact storage.
lore.nomansland.cod_barrel: A barrel packed with Cod, for compact storage.
lore.nomansland.salmon_barrel: A barrel packed with Salmon, for compact storage.
lore.nomansland.billhook_bass_barrel: A barrel packed with Billhook Bass, for compact storage.
lore.nomansland.pufferfish_barrel: A barrel packed with Pufferfish, for compact storage.
lore.nomansland.tropical_fish_barrel: A barrel packed with Tropical Fish, for compact storage.
lore.nomansland.pear_juice: A refreshing bottle of pressed Pears.
lore.nomansland.maple_syrup_bottle: Sweet syrup collected from Maple logs with a Tap and a Cauldron.
lore.nomansland.reeds: A tall plant that grows in shallow water.
lore.nomansland.cattail: A tall plant that grows along the edges of ponds and rivers.
lore.nomansland.beard_moss: A hanging moss that grows from the underside of leaves.
lore.nomansland.rose_vines: A flowering vine that climbs walls.
entity.nomansland.tortoise.description: A passive mob that retreats into its shell when threatened. It is the source of Sturdy Scutes.
entity.nomansland.deer.description: A skittish passive mob found in forests that flees from players. Drops Venison.
entity.nomansland.goose.description: A passive mob found near rivers and lakes.
lore.nomansland.stallion_strip: A single Stallion Strip. Place the Stallion Strips and use them to take a strip.
lore.nomansland.witch_stew: A serving of Witch Stew. Place the Pot of Witch Stew and use a Bowl on it to take a serving.
lore.nomansland.pear_cobbler: A sweet cobbler baked with Pears. Place it and use a Knife on it to cut 4 slices.
